newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba Holdings Q3 load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba Holdings Q3 load factor up.

text.p: Mesaba Holdings Inc, parent of Mesaba Airlines, said the carrier's passenger load factor for the third quarter ended December 31, 1996 rose 3.1 points to 50.2 percent compared with 47.1 percent for the prior year.

It said revenue passenger miles increased in the period to 112.4 million compared with 87.2 million in the same period for the prior year. Available seat miles advanced 20.8 percent to 223.7 million from 185.2 million.
Mesaba Holdings on Wednesday reported third-quarter earnings rose 84.6 percent to $0.24 a share from $0.13 a share.
